sentences: Wassily Kandinsky painted this large canvas in Munich in 1913, filling a surface three metres wide with colour and line.
He made more than thirty studies for it, and the final painting is said to have taken only four days.
At first everything seems to explode outward, yet the colours and lines all turn around a dark vortex just left of centre.
Art historians read in it the Flood, the Resurrection, the Last Judgment and the Garden of Eden, dissolved into one another.
Kandinsky believed colour moves the soul the way music does, which is why he gave the work a musical title, Composition.
Painting a feeling rather than a thing, it became a landmark of what abstract art could do.
Kandinsky himself called it the most complex piece he ever painted.
